application.valued_outcome: Samira wants to visit exhibitions regularly and attend member programs to expand her interests in art and meet people in her borough.
application.justification: An annual membership is cheaper than the per-visit tickets Samira currently pays for and supports her Life Plan goal of independent community outings.

evidence.label: Full page: Brooklyn Museum membership levels and pricing

agent_summary: I reviewed the Brooklyn Museum membership page at https://www.brooklynmuseum.org/support/membership. The organization is open to the general public, offering clear online registration options without private club or sponsorship restrictions. The website publishes an annual Individual Membership fee of $80 per year, with an available $10 discount for seniors and visitors with disabilities. This published rate differs from the $85 per year listed on the application form. Full-page and targeted evidence screenshots have been captured for the audit file.
checklist_notes: IDGS memberships do NOT cover family or dual memberships (or a share of one).
